tagline: A coastal suburb with a beautiful saltwater lake and long beachfront — popular with Istanbul families seeking an affordable seaside lifestyle on the far western shore.

items.name: Büyükçekmece Gölü Sahil Kafeler
items.description: Waterfront cafés around the Büyükçekmece lake with views of the bridge and the lagoon. Peaceful and very local.

items.name: Büyükçekmece Balık Restoranları
items.description: Fresh fish restaurants by the lake and coast. Very good value compared to city-centre equivalents.

items.name: Büyükçekmece Gölü
items.description: A large saltwater lake with a scenic road bridge and waterfront parks. Popular with local families for weekend walks.

tips: Büyükçekmece has no metro — take the metrobus to Beylikdüzü TÜYAP, then a short bus or dolmuş ride.
Far from the city centre — factor in 60+ minutes travel time.
A weekend destination rather than a daily base, unless you work nearby.
The lake and coastal park are the main reasons to make the journey.
